title: Stanford HAI: AI Index Report 2025
description: Comprehensive analysis of AI trends in education from Stanford Human-Centered AI Institute
content: The AI Index tracks progress in AI across multiple dimensions including education adoption, research output, and policy developments. Key findings show exponential growth in AI literacy programs.

title: MIT CSAIL: Teaching AI Ethics to K-12
description: Framework for integrating AI ethics education into K-12 curriculum from MIT Computer Science and AI Lab
content: MIT researchers propose a scaffolded approach to teaching AI ethics, starting with fairness concepts in elementary school and progressing to algorithmic bias in high school.

title: Harvard GSE: Self-Intelligence in the AI Age
description: Research on developing self-awareness and emotional regulation for AI era success
content: Harvard Graduate School of Education identifies four pillars of self-intelligence: self-awareness, resilience, flexibility, and emotional regulation. These skills are critical for human-AI collaboration.

title: CMU Robotics Institute: Hands-On Learning
description: Carnegie Mellon research on the cognitive benefits of robotics education
content: CMU studies show that robotics education significantly improves spatial reasoning, systems thinking, and persistence. Physical manipulation enhances learning retention by 40%.

title: 清华大学：人工智能教育白皮书
description: Tsinghua University comprehensive framework for AI education in Chinese K-12 schools
content: 清华大学发布的AI教育白皮书提出了"理解-应用-创新"三层递进模型，强调培养学生的计算思维和AI素养。

title: Berkeley: Data Science Education Framework
description: UC Berkeley framework for teaching data literacy across all subjects
content: Berkeley Data Science Education Program demonstrates how data literacy can be integrated into humanities, social sciences, and STEM through project-based learning.
